name: Monotonic Stack
tagline: Next Greater Element in O(n) Linear Time
coreIdea: Maintain elements strictly sorted (monotonically increasing or decreasing). When an incoming item violates monotonicity, pop and process resolved boundaries immediately. Each item enters and exits the stack at most once.
whenToUse: Find the next or previous greater / smaller element in O(n)
Calculate largest rectangular area under histogram skyline
Solve trapping rain water and daily temperature spikes
Online stock span and sliding range maximum queries

name: Trie (Prefix Tree)
tagline: Prefix Indexing & Bitwise XOR in O(L) Time
coreIdea: A tree where each node represents a character or bit. Shared prefixes share root paths, converting dictionary searches and longest-prefix checks into fast O(L) path traversals where L is key length.
whenToUse: Instant typeahead prefix validation and autocomplete
Boggle & word search board backtracking pruning
Bitwise maximum XOR pairs using binary 0/1 tries
IP routing table longest subnet prefix matching

name: Sliding Window Maximum
tagline: O(1) Window Extremes with Double-Ended Queues
coreIdea: Use a monotonic deque storing array indices. As the window glides forward, evict indices that fell behind the left boundary from the front, and purge smaller elements from the back before appending.
whenToUse: Maximum or minimum values across moving subarrays of size K
Longest substring with at most K distinct characters
Continuous subarray sum and product bounds

name: Topological Sort (Kahn's)
tagline: Dependency Resolution & Cycle Detection in O(V + E)
coreIdea: Track in-degrees of all vertices. Seed a queue with all zero in-degree nodes (no dependencies). Dequeue nodes, append to order, and decrement neighbors' in-degrees, enqueuing new zero-degree nodes.
whenToUse: Course schedule prerequisites and build systems
Detect cycles in directed dependency graphs
